---qemu-system@fedora.service---
# Automatically generated by qemu-system-generator

[Unit]
SourcePath=@EXAMPLES@/fedora.qemu
Documentation=man:qemu-system(1) man:systemd.service(5) man:systemd.kill(5)
PartOf=machines.target
Before=machines.target
After=network.target
Requires=virtiofsd@fedora-home.socket
After=virtiofsd@fedora-home.socket
Requires=virtiofsd@fedora-home.service
Description=Fedora Cloud Image

[Service]
Type=simple
SyslogIdentifier=qemu-system@%i
RuntimeDirectory=qemu-system/%i
StateDirectory=qemu-system/%i
WorkingDirectory=%S/qemu-system/%i
ExecStart=@QEMU@ \
    -machine q35 \
    -nodefaults \
    -accel kvm \
    -cpu host \
    -m 2048 \
    -smp 2 \
    -drive file=fedora.raw,if=virtio,format=raw \
    -drive file=seed.iso,if=virtio,format=raw,readonly=on \
    -netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:10022-:22 \
    -device virtio-net-pci-non-transitional,netdev=net0,romfile= \
    -device virtio-rng-pci-non-transitional \
    -device vhost-vsock-pci-non-transitional,guest-cid=42 \
    -device virtio-serial-pci-non-transitional \
    -chardev socket,id=console0,path=%t/qemu-system/%i/console.sock,server=on,wait=off \
    -device virtconsole,chardev=console0 \
    -nographic \
    -serial mon:stdio \
    -object memory-backend-memfd,id=mem,size=2048M,share=on \
    -machine memory-backend=mem \
    -chardev socket,id=virtiofs_home,path=%t/virtiofsd/%i-home/virtiofsd.sock \
    -device vhost-user-fs-pci,queue-size=1024,chardev=virtiofs_home,tag=home \
    -qmp unix:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock,server=on,wait=off
ExecStartPost=-@VARLINKCTL@ \
    call \
    %t/systemd/machine/io.systemd.Machine \
    io.systemd.Machine.Register \
    "{\"name\":\"%i\",\"class\":\"vm\",\"service\":\"qemu-system\",\"leader\":${MAINPID},\"vSockCid\":42}"
ExecStop=-@SSH@ \
    -o ConnectTimeout=5 \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
    -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
    -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
    -i %h/.ssh/id_ed25519 \
    root@vsock/42 \
    systemctl poweroff
ExecStop=-@SOCAT@ \
    OPEN:@QMP_POWERDOWN@!!OPEN:/dev/null,wronly \
    UNIX-CONNECT:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock
KillSignal=SIGCONT
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=2min
Slice=machine.slice
DevicePolicy=closed
DeviceAllow=/dev/kvm rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/vhost-vsock rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/vhost-net rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/net/tun rwm
DeviceAllow=char-pts rw

[Install]
WantedBy=machines.target

# Automatically generated by qemu-system-generator

[Unit]
SourcePath=@EXAMPLES@/fedora.qemu
Description=virtiofsd Service for %i
Documentation=https://gitlab.com/virtio-fs/virtiofsd man:systemd.service(5)
StopWhenUnneeded=yes
Before=qemu-system@fedora.service

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=@VIRTIOFSD@ \
    --shared-dir=%h \
    --tag=home \
    --sandbox=namespace \
    --uid-map=:0:%U:1: \
    --gid-map=:0:%G:1: \
    --xattr \
    --no-announce-submounts \
    --fd=3

    -nodefaults \

    -cpu host \
    -m 8G \
    -smp 8 \
    -kernel /path/to/kernel/bzImage \
    -drive file=root.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2 \
    -drive file=test.qcow2,if=none,format=qcow2,id=test \
    -device nvme,serial=test,drive=test \
    -drive file=scratch.qcow2,if=none,format=qcow2,id=scratch \
    -device nvme,serial=scratch,drive=scratch \
    -netdev user,id=net0 \
    -device virtio-net-pci-non-transitional,netdev=net0,romfile= \
    -device virtio-rng-pci-non-transitional \
    -nographic \
    -serial mon:stdio \
    -no-reboot \
    -qmp unix:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock,server=on,wait=off
ExecStartPost=-@VARLINKCTL@ \
    call \
    %t/systemd/machine/io.systemd.Machine \
    io.systemd.Machine.Register \
    "{\"name\":\"%i\",\"class\":\"vm\",\"service\":\"qemu-system\",\"leader\":${MAINPID}}"
ExecStop=-@SOCAT@ \
    OPEN:@QMP_POWERDOWN@!!OPEN:/dev/null,wronly \
    UNIX-CONNECT:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock
KillSignal=SIGCONT
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=2min
Slice=machine.slice

DeviceAllow=char-pts rw
CPUWeight=50

[Unit]
SourcePath=@EXAMPLES@/microvm.qemu
Documentation=man:qemu-system(1) man:systemd.service(5) man:systemd.kill(5)

Description=microvm Guest

[Service]
Type=simple
SyslogIdentifier=qemu-system@%i
RuntimeDirectory=qemu-system/%i
StateDirectory=qemu-system/%i
WorkingDirectory=%S/qemu-system/%i
ExecStart=@QEMU@ \
    -machine microvm,rtc=on,acpi=on \
    -nodefaults \
    -accel kvm \
    -cpu host \
    -m 1024 \
    -smp 2 \
    -kernel /path/to/kernel/bzImage \
    -append "console=ttyS0 root=/dev/vda rw" \
    -drive file=root.raw,if=none,format=raw,id=root \
    -device virtio-blk-device,drive=root \
    -netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:10222-:22 \
    -device virtio-net-device,netdev=net0 \
    -device virtio-rng-device \
    -device vhost-vsock-device,guest-cid=43 \
    -fsdev local,id=fsdev_share,path=/path/to/share,security_model=none,multidevs=remap \
    -device virtio-9p-device,fsdev=fsdev_share,mount_tag=share \
    -nographic \
    -serial mon:stdio \
    -object memory-backend-memfd,id=mem,size=1024M,share=on \
    -machine memory-backend=mem \
    -chardev socket,id=virtiofs_home,path=%t/virtiofsd/%i-home/virtiofsd.sock \
    -device vhost-user-fs-device,queue-size=1024,chardev=virtiofs_home,tag=home \
    -qmp unix:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock,server=on,wait=off
ExecStartPost=-@VARLINKCTL@ \
    call \
    %t/systemd/machine/io.systemd.Machine \
    io.systemd.Machine.Register \
    "{\"name\":\"%i\",\"class\":\"vm\",\"service\":\"qemu-system\",\"leader\":${MAINPID},\"vSockCid\":43}"
ExecStop=-@SOCAT@ \
    OPEN:@QMP_POWERDOWN@!!OPEN:/dev/null,wronly \
    UNIX-CONNECT:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock
KillSignal=SIGCONT

[Unit]
SourcePath=@EXAMPLES@/nixos.qemu
Documentation=man:qemu-system(1) man:systemd.service(5) man:systemd.kill(5)
PartOf=machines.target
Before=machines.target
After=network.target
Requires=virtiofsd@nixos-store.socket

Requires=virtiofsd@nixos-store.service

Requires=virtiofsd@nixos-home.socket
After=virtiofsd@nixos-home.socket
Requires=virtiofsd@nixos-home.service
Description=NixOS over virtiofs

[Service]
Type=simple
SyslogIdentifier=qemu-system@%i
RuntimeDirectory=qemu-system/%i
StateDirectory=qemu-system/%i
WorkingDirectory=%S/qemu-system/%i
ExecStart=@QEMU@ \
    -machine q35 \
    -nodefaults \
    -accel kvm \
    -cpu host,pmu=on \
    -m 4G \
    -smp 4 \
    -uuid 7f3a2b1c-4d5e-4f60-8a7b-9c0d1e2f3a4b \
    -kernel /path/to/kernel/bzImage \
    -initrd /path/to/nixos/initrd \
    -append "console=ttyS0,115200 console=hvc0 init=/nix/store/current-system/init" \
    -drive file=nvme0.qcow2,if=none,format=qcow2,id=nvme0-drive \
    -device nvme,serial=nvme0,drive=nvme0-drive,logical_block_size=4096,physical_block_size=4096 \
    -device nvme,id=nvme1,serial=nvme1,max_ioqpairs=8 \
    -drive file=nvme1n1.qcow2,if=none,format=qcow2,id=nvme1-ns1 \
    -device nvme-ns,drive=nvme1-ns1,bus=nvme1,nsid=1 \
    -drive driver=null-co,if=none,size=1G,read-zeroes=on,id=nvme1-ns2 \
    -device nvme-ns,drive=nvme1-ns2,bus=nvme1,nsid=2,zoned=on,zoned.zone_size=64M \
    -netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:10122-:22 \
    -device virtio-net-pci-non-transitional,netdev=net0,romfile= \
    -device virtio-rng-pci-non-transitional \
    -device vhost-vsock-pci-non-transitional,guest-cid=155 \
    -device virtio-serial-pci-non-transitional \
    -chardev socket,id=console0,path=%t/qemu-system/%i/console.sock,server=on,wait=off \
    -device virtconsole,chardev=console0 \
    -nographic \
    -serial mon:stdio \
    -gdb unix:%t/qemu-system/%i/gdb.sock,server=on,wait=off \
    -S \
    -object memory-backend-memfd,id=mem,size=4G,share=on \
    -machine memory-backend=mem \
    -chardev socket,id=virtiofs_store,path=%t/virtiofsd/%i-store/virtiofsd.sock \
    -device vhost-user-fs-pci,queue-size=1024,chardev=virtiofs_store,tag=store \
    -chardev socket,id=virtiofs_modules,path=%t/virtiofsd/%i-modules/virtiofsd.sock \
    -device vhost-user-fs-pci,queue-size=1024,chardev=virtiofs_modules,tag=modules \
    -chardev socket,id=virtiofs_home,path=%t/virtiofsd/%i-home/virtiofsd.sock \
    -device vhost-user-fs-pci,queue-size=1024,chardev=virtiofs_home,tag=home \
    -qmp unix:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock,server=on,wait=off
ExecStartPost=-@VARLINKCTL@ \
    call \
    %t/systemd/machine/io.systemd.Machine \
    io.systemd.Machine.Register \
    "{\"name\":\"%i\",\"class\":\"vm\",\"service\":\"qemu-system\",\"leader\":${MAINPID},\"vSockCid\":155,\"id\":\"7f3a2b1c-4d5e-4f60-8a7b-9c0d1e2f3a4b\"}"
ExecStop=-@SOCAT@ \
    OPEN:@QMP_POWERDOWN@!!OPEN:/dev/null,wronly \
    UNIX-CONNECT:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock
KillSignal=SIGCONT
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=2min
Slice=machine.slice
DevicePolicy=closed
DeviceAllow=/dev/kvm rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/vhost-vsock rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/vhost-net rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/net/tun rwm
DeviceAllow=char-pts rw
MemoryMax=6G
CPUWeight=200

# Automatically generated by qemu-system-generator

[Unit]
SourcePath=@EXAMPLES@/vfio.qemu
Documentation=man:qemu-system(1) man:systemd.service(5) man:systemd.kill(5)
PartOf=machines.target
Before=machines.target
After=network.target
Description=GPU Passthrough Guest

[Service]
Type=simple
SyslogIdentifier=qemu-system@%i
RuntimeDirectory=qemu-system/%i
StateDirectory=qemu-system/%i
WorkingDirectory=%S/qemu-system/%i
ExecStart=@QEMU@ \
    -machine q35 \
    -nodefaults \
    -accel kvm,kernel-irqchip=split \
    -cpu host \
    -m 8G \
    -smp 8 \
    -device intel-iommu,intremap=on,caching-mode=on \
    -drive if=pflash,format=raw,readonly=on,file=/usr/share/OVMF/OVMF_CODE_4M.fd \
    -drive if=pflash,format=raw,file=ovmf-vars.fd \
    -drive file=root.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2 \
    -device vfio-pci,host=0000:01:00.0 \
    -netdev user,id=net0 \
    -device virtio-net-pci-non-transitional,netdev=net0,romfile= \
    -device virtio-rng-pci-non-transitional \
    -nographic \
    -serial mon:stdio \
    -qmp unix:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock,server=on,wait=off
ExecStartPost=-@VARLINKCTL@ \
    call \
    %t/systemd/machine/io.systemd.Machine \
    io.systemd.Machine.Register \
    "{\"name\":\"%i\",\"class\":\"vm\",\"service\":\"qemu-system\",\"leader\":${MAINPID}}"
ExecStop=-@SOCAT@ \
    OPEN:@QMP_POWERDOWN@!!OPEN:/dev/null,wronly \
    UNIX-CONNECT:%t/qemu-system/%i/qmp.sock
KillSignal=SIGCONT
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=2min
Slice=machine.slice
DevicePolicy=closed
DeviceAllow=/dev/kvm rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/vhost-vsock rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/vhost-net rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/net/tun rwm
DeviceAllow=char-pts rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/vfio/vfio rw
DeviceAllow=char-vfio rw
LimitMEMLOCK=infinity
